evidence.quote: ## 5. The complete resource bill and the executed receiver

The L_j are ACTUAL calibrated physical VACUUM input-output ports including phases;ALL modeled outputs reach Bob coherently and LOSSLESSLY. Bob has programmable local H_M(t),C_j(t) on d^2 receiver levels,initialized by a Bell state between his OWN two d-level registers,uncorrelated with source/no shared entanglement. Source H/ports remain immutable. Chronological one-pass field interaction,no future-slice access,reversal,source feedback or later source access. These physical port/control resources are premises,not supplied by knowing a reduced generator. Collection applies for any finite horizonT;deterministic full-payload transfer additionally requires source forgetting/replacement at that horizon.

At FIXED source/horizon,source gives sufficientpeakO(delta^-1) andconservativeprogramlengthO(delta^-5). Dense controlstorageO(N(m+1)d^4),dense root/SylvestersolvesO(d^6). No new Capital/root scientific replay,reproof,independent audit overlay,external gate or priority finding. All actual pure ports,lossless coherent delivery and programmable full receiver matrices remain required. This does not close P2 finite-bandwidth/loss/competitive-device gap,prove arbitrary thermal-input causal reception or imply a laboratory rate/advantage. d^2 levels and dense costs scale in d,not efficiently in source qubit countlogd.
